title: Inpatient Care.
hero.text: 24/7 inpatient care with expert medical supervision, nursing support, and rehabilitation services tailored to your recovery.

intro.heading: Inpatient Rehabilitation Services
text: Cambridge Hospital’s inpatient rehabilitation services support patients who require intensive therapy, continuous nursing care and close medical oversight in a structured clinical environment. These services are designed for complex medical recovery, post-acute rehabilitation, ventilated patients care, pediatric rehabilitation and long-term support.
